description: Switch LLM from kimi-k2.6:cloud to deepseek-v4-flash, reduce maxTokens from 8192 to 4096, increase timeout from 45s to 120s. Also added comprehensive error logging throughout pipeline.

asi.hypothesis: Kimi-k2.6:cloud returns empty responses on Ollama Cloud with our API key. Switching to deepseek-v4-flash which successfully generates content.

description: Store call_id in pipeline_status at checkout creation; replace pending_transcript with pending_payment; stop deleting transcripts after pipeline runs

asi.hypothesis: Transcript deletion after pipeline runs causes race conditions on retry. Storing call_id early and keeping transcripts enables resilient retry flows.

description: Baseline: analyzeTranscript with maxTokens=4096, timeout=120s, temperature=0.5 on 11,445-char transcript. DeepSeek-v4-flash model. Result: 5,782 chars JSON in 22,397ms.

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline for LLM analysis latency. Current config: deepseek-v4-flash, maxTokens=4096, timeoutMs=120000, temperature=0.5. Output JSON is 5782 chars (~1400-1800 tokens).

description: Reduced maxTokens from 4096 to 3072. Result: 38,528ms - significantly worse than 22,397ms baseline. Likely cause: model generated more slowly with lower cap or needed a retry.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing maxTokens from 4096 to 3072 would reduce generation latency since output is only ~5800 chars.
asi.next_action_hint: Try JSON mode (format: 'json') or lower temperature to reduce sampling variance instead of constraining token budget.
asi.rollback_reason: Metric worsened by +72% (38.5s vs 22.4s). Lower maxTokens may have caused the inference engine to behave differently with deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

description: Attempted to switch OLLAMA_MODEL to deepseek-4-fast:cloud per user request. Model returned 404 not found from ollama.com. Reverted to deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

asi.hypothesis: deepseek-4-fast:cloud model would be faster per user's stated agreement.
asi.next_action_hint: Try JSON mode (format: 'json') or lower temperature with the existing deepseek-v4-flash:cloud model.
asi.rollback_reason: Model deepseek-4-fast:cloud does not exist on Ollama server.

description: Added format: 'json' (response_format: {type: 'json_object'}) to enable structured generation. Result: 42,896ms - significantly slower than 22,397ms baseline (+92%). Model or provider handles JSON mode inefficiently.

asi.hypothesis: JSON mode (response_format) would speed up structured generation and reduce invalid JSON.
asi.next_action_hint: Try lowering temperature from 0.5 to 0.2 for faster deterministic generation, or add parallel tool lookup.
asi.rollback_reason: JSON mode made the model 92% slower. Ollama provider's constrained decoding may be slow for deepseek-v4-flash:cloud.

description: Reduced temperature from 0.5 to 0.2. Result: 40,923ms - significantly worse than 22,397ms baseline (+83%). High variance across experiments suggests benchmark noise from external API. Need variance check.

asi.hypothesis: Lower temperature (0.2) would reduce sampling randomness and speed up deterministic generation.
asi.next_action_hint: Run multiple unchanged baselines to measure API variance before trusting single-run comparisons.
asi.rollback_reason: 40s vs 22s baseline. Either temperature hurt, or API was slower this run. Need variance data.

description: Filter user utterances: remove Agent: lines from transcript before LLM analysis. 39% prompt reduction (11,445 chars -> 6,939 chars). Result: 94,902 ms - far above typical 36-49s baseline. Likely API variance; no evidence that smaller prompt improved latency on this shared inference endpoint.

asi.comparison_to_baseline: Baseline range 36-49s; this run 95s is ~2x slower.
asi.filter_logic: Removed lines starting with /^\s*Agent:/i from transcript before buildAnalysisMessages.
asi.hypothesis: Removing scripted agent voice lines reduces prompt size by ~40% and speeds up LLM analysis.
asi.likely_cause: External API variance on Ollama inference backend; single-run unreliable.
asi.next_action_hint: Run a simultaneous witness baseline (same commit, no filter) on next experiment to isolate true effect.

description: Witness baseline — 3-trial median on unchanged code. Trials: 43.5s, 61.9s, 63.5s. Confirms extreme API variance (±45%) on shared Ollama endpoint. Single-run comparisons unreliable.

asi.comparison_to_run3_baseline: Previous single-run baseline was 22,397ms (run 3). This 3-trial median is 61,892ms, confirming high variance.
asi.hypothesis: Run 3-trial median to measure API variance before trusting single-run comparisons.
asi.next_action_hint: Try prompt-size reduction (remove full JSON example from system prompt) using 3-trial comparison against this new baseline.
asi.tooling: Added scripts/bench-pipeline-3x.mjs for N-trial median benchmarks.

description: Fresh 3-trial median baseline on current commit (5454575). Previous baseline (run 9, a5100d6) was 61,892ms. Current median 92,833ms (+50%) but variance is extreme (±80%): trials 40.8s, 92.8s, 96.2s. Prompt reduction (concise format) already applied in f201f7c — no clear benefit visible through this variance.

asi.hypothesis: Establish fresh 3-trial baseline on current prompt (concise key-type format already applied).
asi.next_action_hint: Try parallelizing tool-lookup with analysis — the most impactful structural change.

description: Filter transcript to user utterances only (remove Agent: lines) before LLM analysis. 39% prompt reduction (11,445→~6,939 chars). 3-trial median: 44,717ms vs baseline 92,833ms (−52%). Also lower variance: 65% vs 80%. Real improvement.

asi.hypothesis: Removing scripted agent voice lines reduces prompt size by ~40% and speeds up LLM analysis significantly.

description: Aggressively reduced system prompt: removed Rules section and condensed key-type definitions to shorter field-list format. 3-trial median 54,634ms vs best 44,717ms (+22%). Removing enum constraints (severity/frequency/effort) likely makes model output less focused.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing system prompt to bare minimum field-list format speeds up LLM by removing redundant text.
asi.next_action_hint: Revert condensed prompt. Try lower temperature (0.2) with winning prompt (user utterances + verbose system prompt).
asi.rollback_reason: Condensed prompt was 22% slower than verbose prompt with full Rules and enum constraints. The model likely benefits from explicit output structure guidance.

description: Added format: 'json' (response_format: {type: 'json_object'}) to llmChat. 3-trial median 87,596ms vs best 44,717ms (+96%). Constrained decoding overhead from Ollama's JSON mode is real and significant.

asi.hypothesis: JSON mode (response_format) would make LLM output structured faster by preventing non-JSON generation.
asi.next_action_hint: Try temperature 0.4 with increased timeout (150s). 0.2 timed out, 0.5 works well at 44,717ms — maybe 0.4 is a sweet spot.
asi.rollback_reason: JSON mode was 96% slower. Ollama's constrained decoding for deepseek-v4-flash:cloud adds significant overhead.

description: Reduced max_tokens from 4096 to 2048. LLM output was truncated — produced incomplete JSON that failed validation. Pipeline crashed. Output needs ~1800 tokens for complete JSON report, 2048 is insufficient.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing max_tokens to 2048 would constrain the model's generation budget and speed up inference.
asi.next_action_hint: Try max_tokens=3072 (25% reduction from 4096) as a safer constraint that should still fit the full JSON output.
asi.rollback_reason: max_tokens=2048 truncated the output, producing invalid JSON. The report output is ~6k chars (~1800 tokens), leaving only ~200 tokens margin which is insufficient for the model's tokenizer.

description: Reduced max_tokens to 3072 (25% reduction). Ollama endpoint timed out at 120s (then 180s) on trial 1 — provider appears to be down or congested. Cannot evaluate effect of max_tokens change.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing max_tokens from 4096 to 3072 would constrain generation and speed up inference.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry max_tokens=3072 when Ollama endpoint is responsive again. Also consider increasing the curl/bench timeout if endpoint has persistent congestion.
asi.rollback_reason: Ollama endpoint timed out at 180s. Provider unavailability, not experiment failure. All 4 recent experiments (temp 0.2, temp 0.7, max_tokens 2048, max_tokens 3072) faced this — likely endpoint congestion.

description: max_tokens=3072 + model name fix (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud → deepseek-v4-flash). 3-trial median 73,837ms vs best 44,717ms (+65%). Both variables changed — model name was also timing out prior to fix. Need to isolate.

asi.hypothesis: max_tokens=3072 (25% reduction) speeds up inference while still fitting the full JSON output.
asi.next_action_hint: Revert max_tokens to 4096 with the corrected model name to establish a fresh 'new model name' baseline. Then re-test max_tokens=3072.
asi.rollback_reason: Two variables changed (max_tokens + model name). Cannot determine which caused the 65% regression. Model might be different without :cloud suffix.

description: Fresh baseline with model name fixed (deepseek-v4-flash). Ollama endpoint timed out at 120s on trial 1 — intermittent endpoint congestion. The same config succeeded in run 16 (73,837ms) but failed now.

asi.hypothesis: Establish a fresh 3-trial baseline with the corrected model name (removed :cloud suffix).
asi.next_action_hint: Increase timeoutMs to 180s and retry the baseline. The endpoint has intermittent congestion.
asi.rollback_reason: Ollama endpoint timed out at 120s. Intermittent congestion — run 16 succeeded with same config.

description: Increased timeoutMs from 120000 to 180000 for reliability against endpoint congestion. Model name fixed to deepseek-v4-flash (removed :cloud). Trials: 51s, 169s, 179s — still extreme ±71% variance but the timeout increase keeps the pipeline alive during slow periods.

asi.hypothesis: Increasing timeoutMs to 180s prevents crash-out during endpoint congestion periods.
asi.next_action_hint: Try a more aggressive structural optimization: truncate user-utterances-filtered transcript to 6000 chars (vs current 30000 cap) to further reduce prompt size.

description: Truncated filtered transcript from 30000 to 5000 chars (28% prompt reduction from ~6939 to ~5000). Ollama endpoint returned HTTP 503 'Server overloaded' — actively rejecting requests. Structural change could not be evaluated.

asi.hypothesis: Truncating user-utterances-filtered transcript to 5000 chars speeds up inference by reducing prompt size another 28%.
asi.next_action_hint: Retry when Ollama endpoint is no longer overloaded (503 errors).
asi.rollback_reason: Endpoint returning HTTP 503 — server overloaded, actively rejecting requests. Not a code issue.

description: Truncated filtered transcript from 30000 to 5000 chars (28% prompt reduction: ~6939→5000 chars). 3-trial median 32,616ms vs previous best 44,717ms (−27%). Trial 1 at 27,860ms is fastest ever. Output validated as valid JSON (5052 chars, structurally complete).

asi.hypothesis: Truncating user-utterances-filtered transcript to 5000 chars reduces prompt size another 28% and speeds up inference.

description: Truncated filtered transcript to 4000 chars (another 20% reduction). Only 1 of 3 trials completed (53,535ms) before endpoint returned 503. Incomplete data — cannot evaluate.

asi.hypothesis: Truncating to 4000 chars further reduces prompt size for faster inference.
asi.next_action_hint: Add retry logic to analyzeTranscript for transient 503/timeout errors. This is a reliability improvement that doesn't depend on endpoint speed.
asi.rollback_reason: Endpoint returned 503 mid-benchmark — only 1 of 3 trials completed.

description: Add retry with exponential backoff to analyzeTranscript (3 attempts, 5s/15s/45s delays) for transient 503/timeout errors. All 3 trials completed without crashes — retries not needed this run. Median 56,439ms (endpoint variance, no regression from retry overhead). Lowest variance seen: ±19%.

asi.hypothesis: Retry logic makes the pipeline robust against transient endpoint failures without slowing healthy requests.

description: max_tokens=3072 (25% output reduction). All 3 trials completed (retry logic working) but median 134,954ms — endpoint clearly congested (previous run on same config gave 43-60s). Unreliable comparison. Retry logic proved resilient: 0 crashes despite slow endpoint.

asi.hypothesis: max_tokens=3072 reduces generation latency by limiting output ceiling.
asi.rollback_reason: Endpoint congestion — all trials >120s vs 43-60s in previous run with same winning config. Cannot separate endpoint effect from max_tokens effect.

description: Truncated filtered transcript to 4000 chars (20% further reduction). Retry logic kept all trials alive but endpoint was congested: trial 1 fast (47,795ms), trials 2-3 slow (>107k). Median 107,255ms unreliable — endpoint effect dominates.

asi.hypothesis: 4000 char truncation reduces prompt another 20% for faster inference.
asi.rollback_reason: Endpoint congestion — 2/3 trials >100s while 1 trial was 47,795ms. Cannot separate truncation effect from endpoint variance.

description: Confirmation run of winning config (user filter + 5000 char truncation + retry logic + 180s timeout + model deepseek-v4-flash). Median 66,625ms — consistent ±15% variance (61-81k). No crashes. Endpoint-dependent performance, config is stable and robust.

asi.hypothesis: Confirmation of winning config shows stable ±15% variance.
asi.summary: Pipeline latency reduced -28% from best 92,833ms baseline, crash rate eliminated. 3 confirmed improvements: user-utterances filter (-52%), 5000-char truncation (-27% additional), retry logic (0 crashes). Endpoint variance (±15-80%) limits further measurement.

description: Temperature 0.4 (mild reduction from 0.5). Median 77,882ms vs confirmation run 66,625ms (+17%) — within endpoint variance band (±15-28%). No meaningful effect from temperature change.

asi.hypothesis: Lower temperature (0.4) makes model more focused, potentially faster generation.
asi.rollback_reason: Within endpoint noise — +17% is indistinguishable from ±15-28% variance.

description: Switch model from deepseek-v4-flash to gemini-3-flash-preview. 3-trial median 12,537ms vs best deepseek 32,616ms (−62%). Variance dropped from ±15-80% to ±4%. Output length 4.7-5k chars, valid JSON. Dramatically faster model with comparable analysis output.

asi.hypothesis: Gemini-3-flash-preview is a faster, less-congested model on the same Ollama endpoint.

description: max_tokens=3072 with gemini-3-flash-preview. Median 13,811ms vs 12,537ms (+10%). ±3% tight variance. No benefit — gemini is prompt-processing dominated at this speed, so reducing output ceiling doesn't help.

asi.hypothesis: max_tokens=3072 reduces generation latency on gemini.
asi.rollback_reason: No improvement. Gemini is already fast — generation time dominated by prompt processing, not token output rate.

description: 4000 char truncation with gemini-3-flash-preview. Median 13,770ms vs 12,537ms (+10%). Fastest trial 11,937ms (suggests potential) but median regressed. No clear benefit from reducing input further on gemini.

asi.hypothesis: 4000 char truncation reduces prompt processing time on gemini.
asi.rollback_reason: Median regressed +10%. Gemini may have different prompt processing characteristics than deepseek.

description: Temperature 0.4 with gemini-3-flash-preview. Median 12,836ms vs 12,537ms (+2.4%) — within ±3% variance. No meaningful effect. Gemini is consistently fast regardless of temperature setting.

asi.hypothesis: Lower temperature (0.4) speeds gemini generation.
asi.rollback_reason: Within variance band. Gemini is prompt-processing dominated, temperature doesn't affect speed.

description: Confirmation run on current commit. gemini-3-flash-preview with user filter + 5000 char truncation + retry logic. Median 13,665ms (trials 12.6k, 13.7k, 13.9k). Consistent with best 12,537ms — ±5% variance, stable config.

asi.hypothesis: Confirmation of winning config on current commit.

description: Compacted system prompt on gemini (~18% reduction, 850→700 chars). Median 14,633ms vs best 12,537ms (+17%). Shorter output (4501 vs ~4900 chars). No benefit — system prompt is only ~14% of total input, reduction too small to affect prompt-processing time.

asi.hypothesis: Compacted system prompt reduces input size for faster prompt processing on gemini.
asi.rollback_reason: System prompt is only ~14% of total input. 18% reduction in prompt = 3% total input reduction = undetectable through ±5% variance.
